lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Please... can you go faster? I am late for work.

lines.speaker: TaxiDriver
lines.text: Traffic is heavy today, my friend. But I know a short way.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: How long... how much time to Deira?

lines.speaker: TaxiDriver
lines.text: Maybe twenty minutes. My brother, you are safe with me.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Okay. Thank you. Please... just please hurry.

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: أَهْلًا يَا صَاحْبِي! أَنَا مَحْمُود، وَدِي حَلْقَة تَانِي مِن يَلَّا فْلُوئَنْت... النَّهَارْدَة مَكَّال رَاكِب تَاكْسِي، وَمِتْأَخِّر عَن الشُّغْل، وَالسَّوَاقْ رَاجُو بِيَقُول لُه كَلَام كِتِير!

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: اسْمَع كْوَيِّس... فِي الْحَلْقَة دِي، هَنِتْعَلَّم تَلَاتَة عِبَارَات مُهِمَّة جِدًّا: الْأَوَّلَانِي 'How long'... يَعْنِي كَم الْوَقْت.
lines.direction: slowing down on the English phrase, clear

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: وَالتَّانْيَة 'go faster'... يَعْنِي امْشِي أَسْرَع. وَالتَّالْتَة 'Can you please'... أَدَبْ وَلُطْف، وَدِي أَهَمّ وَاحْدَة!
lines.direction: playful emphasis on the last phrase

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: يَلَّا بِينَا نِسْمَع مَكَّال وَرَاجُو فِي التَّاكْسِي... وَخُد بِالك، هَتِسْمَع كُلْ عِبَارَة دِي بِالْإِنْجِلِيزِي وَاضِح!
lines.direction: excited, inviting, gentle handoff to the scene

lines.speaker: TaxiDriver
lines.text: Relax, my friend. Look, I take the small road now. We go behind the big mosque, then straight to Deira.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Okay... okay. But how long now? The time... how long to Deira?

lines.speaker: TaxiDriver
lines.text: Fifteen minutes, maybe less. Do not worry. My brother, you are safe with me.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: My boss is not happy if I am late again. Can you please go faster? Please.

lines.speaker: TaxiDriver
lines.text: I go faster, yes. But the police... they stop me if I am too fast. You understand?

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Yes. I understand. I do not want a problem for you. Just... please, go the short way. I live here since two years, but this road is new for me.

lines.speaker: TaxiDriver
lines.text: Two years? You speak good English, my friend. Okay. I take the bridge now. Look, see? Deira is there, near the water.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Thank you. Thank you very much. Can you please stop near the coffee shop? Dune and Company. The big building with the blue glass.

lines.speaker: TaxiDriver
lines.text: Of course. Two minutes. I stop at the corner. You walk small, small to the door.

lines.speaker: Nour
lines.text: Macal! Hey! You made it. I was starting to worry. We have the meeting in ten minutes.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Nour... hi. Sorry. The traffic was very bad. But I am here now. I am here.

lines.speaker: Nour
lines.text: Breathe. You are fine. Come on, let us go up. Tarek is already in the room.

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: يَلَّا يَا صَاحْبِي، نْشُوفْ مَكَّال قَال إِيهْ فِي التَّاكْسِي... أُولَ حَاجَة: How long... يَعْنِي كَم الْوَقْت، وِلَمَّا تِسْأَل عَن مُدَّة، تِقُول: How long to Deira? وَثَانِي حَاجَة: Can you please... دِي أَدَبْ وَلُطْف، زَي: Can you please stop here? وَتَلَاتَة: go faster... يَعْنِي امْشِي أَسْرَع، زَي: Can you please go faster?

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: بَسْ خُد بِالك مِن غَلْطَة صَغِيرَة... مَكَّال قَال: I live here since two years. لِيهْ؟ لِأَن فِي الْعَرَبِي بِنْقُول 'مِن سَنِتَيْن'، فَالدِّمَاغ بِيْجِيب since... لَكِن فِي الْأَمْرِيكِي، بِنْقُول: I have lived here for two years. أَو أَبْسَط: I have been here for two years. غَلْطَة عَادِيَّة جِدًّا، كُل الْعَالَم بِتْعْمِل كِدَا!

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: دِلْوَقْتِي الْمُهِمّ... الْأَكْسِنْت لَابْ! النَّهَارْدَة هَنِشْتَغَل عَلَى صَوْت الـ Flap-T. فِي الْأَمْرِيكِي، لَمَّا حَرْف T يِيجِي بَيْن حَرْفِين مُتَحَرِّكِين، بِيْبْقَى زَي دَالْ نَاعْمَة... water بِيْبْقَى wader... city بِيْبْقَى ciddy... later بِيْبْقَى lader.
lines.direction: playful, clear articulation, accent lab energy

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: طَيَّب، مِنْ كَلَام مَكَّال فِي التَّاكْسِي... كَلِمَة little. الْغَلَط: لِيتِّل... بِتِّينْ قَوِيَّة. الصَّح: لِيدِل... lader صَوْت الْـ T خَفِيف. وَكَمَان: better... بِيْدَر... جَرِّبْ مَعَايَا: better... better... little... little. كْوَيِّس! مِمْتَاز! دِي الْحَكَايَة، يَلَّا نِرْجَع لِلْأَحْدَاث!
lines.direction: coach drill, upbeat, then transitions back to story

lines.speaker: Nour
lines.text: Macal, wait. Look at the screen. Mr. Rahman moved the meeting. It is at ten thirty now, not ten.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Ten thirty? So I am not late. Really? I am not late.

lines.speaker: Nour
lines.text: Not late. You have been here for two years and you still worry like it is your first week.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: I have been here for two years... and I still count every minute. That is true. Okay. I can breathe now.
lines.direction: small proud smile, using the corrected form

lines.speaker: Nour
lines.text: Good. Hey, the coffee here is better than the coffee in our building. Can you please get me a small one? I will save us two seats upstairs.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Of course. A small coffee. Wait for me near the lift.

lines.speaker: Barista
lines.text: Hello, sir. What can I get for you today?

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: One small coffee, please. And... can you please make it a little sweet? Just a little.
lines.direction: clear and polite, relaxed Flap-T on little

lines.speaker: Barista
lines.text: A little sweet. Got it. That will be twelve dirhams.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Here you are. Thank you very much.

lines.speaker: Nour
lines.text: Macal! Up here! Third floor. Come on, we are good on time.

lines.speaker: Tarek
lines.text: Ah, of course you know the receptionist here too. Everyone loves Tarek.

lines.speaker: Nour
lines.text: Macal... look who is at the front desk. He is laughing with the new girl like he owns the building.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: I do not know how he does it. But I have my coffee, I have my time... and I have you on my side. Let us go up.

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: طَيَّب يَا جَمَاعَة... نِرَاجِعْ بِسُرْعَة: كُنَّا بِنْسْأَل عَن الْوَقْت بِـ How long، وَبِنْطَلُب بِأَدَب بِـ Can you please، وَبِنِقُول go faster... يَعْنِي امْشِي أَسْرَع. وَكَمَان صَوْت الـ Flap-T: little بِيْبْقَى لِيدِل، better بِيْبْقَى بِيدَر.

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: وَعِبَارَة الْحَلْقَة النَّهَارْدَة... Can you please go faster? ... دِي هِيَّ! عِبَارَة صَغِيرَة، بَسْ بِتَفْتَح لَك أَبْوَاب كَتَيْر فِي دُبَيْ.

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: دِلْوَقْتِي دَوْرَك... سَجِّل فُويس نُوت صَغِير، قُول فِيه Can you please go faster? بِصَوْت وَاضِح، ورَكِّز عَلَى الْـ T الْخَفِيفَة. مَتْخَافْش مِن الْغَلَط، إِحْنَا هِنْشَجِّعَك!

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: وَاِبْعَتْهَا لَنَا عَلَى تِلِيجْرَام... فِي Empire English Community. إِحْنَا مَعَاك، هَنِسْمَع صَوْتَك، وَهَنِرَد عَلَيْك. الْعَيْلَة كِبِيرَة، وَأَنْتَ مِنَّا!

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: يَلَّا يَا بَطَل... اِرْفَع صَوْتَك، وَخُد خُطْوَة أَسْرَع! يَلَّا فْلُوَنْت... نِشُوفْك فِي الْحَلْقَة الْجَايَة!

phonetic_focus.note: In American English, T between vowels sounds like a soft D: water -> 'wader', city -> 'ciddy', later -> 'lader'.
